newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks slip slightly after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks slip slightly after U.S. data.

text.p: French shares slipped slightly after the publication of U.S. November personal income data, giving up very slight gains made in early afternoon. Operators expected a lower opening of Wall Street.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was unchanged at 2,278.63 at 1333 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was up at 2,286 from 2,280 on Friday's close.
Shares had been trading down most of the day due to profit taking on the last day of the December account.
